messages:
deploy-bot: Release v3.2.1 scheduled by @sasha. Initiating surgical tilt to blue pool in quiet window (02:00 UTC). Canary config: cohorts, short probes, rollback gates.

sasha: going live in 90s. infra quiet window confirmed by @mario. brief checklist: pin session route, disable sticky cookie fallback, prepare rollback commands. :rocket:

mario: SRE/oncall (ciara) looped. I have dashboard open (latency, 5xx, traces) and an alert channel. If anything spikes, call a hold and rollback.

elaine: config note — must set router pin for new variant to preserve sticky sessions. plan: 2% -> 8% -> 25% -> 100% with 3m probe windows. I'll do weight changes manually to avoid autoscaler flaps.

ben: watch kv-cache hitrate. v3.2.1 invalidates small prefix; expecting transient miss rate bump. Threshold: p95 latency up >40% OR error_rate >0.5% sustained 3m -> rollback.

sasha: rollout commands (copy/paste):
```sh
# add small weight to blue pool
rbctl route update --route=main-api --variant=blue --weight=2
# probe for 3m, then increase
rbctl route update --route=main-api --variant=blue --weight=8
```

ciara: watching logs + traces now. forwarding important links: https://grafana/release/v3-2-1  and flamegraph link.

deploy-bot: Tilt step 1 complete: blue weight=2%. health checks: ok. p95 latency delta: +3%. errors: 0.02%.

elaine: increasing to 8% in 30s. keeping canary cohorts pinned by session cookie. rolling out cohorts A/B only.

mario: reminder - keep load balancer drain timeout at 45s for this cutover to avoid long tail. If connection churn >5% during tilt, pause and investigate.

sasha: increasing to 8% now. will wait 3m then decide next bump.

ciara: after first bump, small spike in cache misses but CPU flat. nothing alarming. continuing to monitor.

deploy-bot: Tilt step 2 complete: blue weight=8%. metrics stable. no rollback triggered. next planned: 25% in 4m.

ben: pre-announce to partners channel and docs team to publish light release notes: highlight session pinning change and kv-cache bump.

elaine: proceeding to 25% now. if p95 > 150ms OR error_rate >0.5% -> immediate rollback and set blue weight=0.

sasha: hold on — observed a small 0.25% error bump in EU region only. Ciara, can you narrow to edge pool?

ciara: yes, looks like eu-edge-4 has 5xxs from a single host. I'm shunting traffic away from eu-edge-4 and restarting agent.

mario: good move. keep tilt paused until EU clears. set planned next bump to manual only after 2 green probes.

deploy-bot: Action: paused tilt at 8% per manual instruction from @mario. Record: pause_reason=eu-edge-4-5xx, paused_by=mario.

elaine: once eu-edge-4 back to green, we'll resume to 25% and then follow to 100%. For resume: run
```sh
rbctl route update --route=main-api --variant=blue --weight=25
```

sasha: agree. if the restart doesn't fix it in 7m, we'll rollback to 0% and cut a postmortem.

ciara: eu-edge-4 looks healthy after restart. monitoring 2m for stability.

mario: green for 3m now. resume when ready, but increment to 25% only once docs & support are notified.

ben: I've drafted a 2-line release note and pinged support.

elaine: resuming tilt -> setting 25% now.

deploy-bot: Tilt step 3 complete: blue weight=25%. metrics: p95 +6%, error_rate 0.12%. No rollback gates hit.

sasha: final bump to 100% in 10m if stable. We'll keep session pin for 1h then remove. Flagging post-release: check kv-cache hit steady at baseline in 2h.

ciara: I'll stay on watch for the next 30m then hand off to infra oncall.

mario: thanks everyone. nice and surgical. if any rollback needed:
```sh
# immediate rollback
rbctl route update --route=main-api --variant=blue --weight=0
rbctl route update --route=main-api --variant=green --weight=100
```

sasha: release v3.2.1 promoted to stable after 30m no-gates. closing thread; will file short post-release notes. :white_check_mark:
